The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} equips to the {{Icon|hammer}} slot and is used when constructing [[blueprints]] and during several other select operations.  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can be forged at the [[anvil]] or can be purchased from the [[blacksmith]].  The hammer tool progression maybe bugged as [[Rusty hammer]] could only be crafted at the [[Anvil II]] and Iron hammers require steel and have the Steel Hammer sprite in-game.

Efficiency represents how much progress toward an operation each swing of the Hammer provides.  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} provides 100% efficiency. 

Energy usage represents how much energy each operation consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} requires {{Energy|-|1}} per swing.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|100}}.
